purpose: Implement a single experiment-ID-driven, fail-closed baseline trainer for the six frozen seed-42 YOLO11s conditions, with governed multi-session continuation through RESUME-01.

ddp_initialization_policy.upstream_observation: BaseTrainer initializes outer rank RNG as args.seed + 1 + RANK; configured seed 42 therefore corresponds to rank-0 outer RNG seed 43 under DDP.
ddp_initialization_policy.governed_resolution: GovernedDetectionTrainer isolates model construction under the configured seed 42 and restores the outer DDP RNG state immediately afterward.
ddp_initialization_policy.reason: Preserve the INIT-01 seed-42 pretrained-versus-scratch initialization contract without changing rank-specific data/augmentation RNG behavior.

dataset_preflight.membership_identity: Immediate-directory image and label stems are sorted, joined with newline separators plus a final newline, and SHA256 matched to DATA-01.
dataset_preflight.split_b_aug_rule: Frozen membership remains 28,454; operational count is 28,452 after deterministic exclusion of the two recorded unreadable PNGs.

provenance.experiment_source_commit_rule: Training is blocked while EXPERIMENTS.csv source_commit is blank. After the RESUME-01 implementation commit is remotely CI-verified, a separate authorization commit binds that frozen implementation SHA into all six rows. Execution may occur only on descendants whose guarded scientific/runtime paths are unchanged; resume sessions additionally require the exact execution commit recorded by the original session.
provenance.experiment_matrix_authorization_rule: After source commit S is bound, all EXPERIMENTS.csv fields must match S exactly except source_commit, and all six source_commit cells must equal S.
